div.head: II Eg 5.1
div.ab: ⁊ man beboden fæsten healde mid ælcre geornfulnesse.
⁊ man ælc beboden fæsten healde mid ælcere geornfulnesse.
Et omne indictum ieiunium cum omni deuotione seruetur.
⁊ man ælc bebodon fæsten healde mid ælcere geornfulnesse [⁊ ælces Frigedæges fæsten, buton hit freols sy]. [A]
And every fast which has been appointed shall be rigorously observed, [and the fast every Friday, unless it be a festival].
And every appointed fast is to be observed with all diligence [and the fast every Friday, unless it is a festival.].
Und man halte (jedes A D) gebotene Fasten mit aller Bereitwilligkeit (und das Fasten jedes Freitags, ausser wenn es ein Fest ist A).
And let (every, A D) commanded fast be kept with all eagerness (and the fast of every Friday, unless it is a feast-day, A).
div.note: A adds ‘⁊ ælces Frigedæges fæsten, buton hit freols sy’.

The words within brackets in 5.1, and chaps 5.2 and 5.3, are only in the Wulfstan MSS. Ciricgrið “right of sanctuary” occurs elsewhere in laws only in the codes which he dratted. The addition to chap. 5.1. is in I Cnut 16a (cf. V Ethelred 17, VI 24): chap. 5.2 is mainly in V Ethelred 12.1 (= VI 21 = I Cnut 13.1).
